To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

γδ T cell activation of dendritic cells via the CD40 ligand/CD40 signalling pathway is critical for the early phase of the immune response to Plasmodium parasites, but not for the elimination of parasites.
γδ T cell activation via CD40‐CD40 ligand signalling is critical for the elimination of malaria parasites in mice.
γδ T cell–mediated CD40 signalling is critical for dendritic cell activation during early Plasmodium infections. γδ T cells are important in the control of Plasmodial infections.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of γδ T cells during malaria infection and the mechanism of γδ T cell action.
the role of γδ T cells in the immune response against Plasmodium parasites.
the mechanism of γδ T cell function during the early phase in malaria infection.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
γδ T cell–dendritic cell cross‐talk via CD40 signalling plays a critical role in the control of malaria infection during the early phase.
γδ T cell–mediated dendritic cell activation through CD40–CD40 ligand interaction plays a pivotal role during the early phase in Plasmodium‐induced protective immunity.
γδ T cell–dendritic cell interaction via CD40 signalling is critical for the early control of Plasmodial infection.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CD40 signalling is critical in the early phase of malaria infection, and the protective effects of CD40 signalling can be achieved by dendritic cell activation through γδ T cells.
γδ T cell–dendritic cell interactions are critical during the early stage of malaria infection, and that CD40 signalling between dendritic cells and γδ T cells can eliminate parasites in the liver.
the CD40 ligand/CD40 signalling between γδ T cells and dendritic cells is essential for the early control of Plasmodia.
The main takeaway from our work is that
dendritic cell–T cell cross‐talk is essential during the early phase for the development of an effective anti‐parasitic response.
CD40 signalling is critical for the activation of γδ T cells during Plasmodium infections.
CD40 signalling between dendritic cells and γδ T cells is essential for the control of malaria.
